​Description
​LP10 Universal — Halloween Edition is a feature-rich, haunted command hub for mobile and PC executors. It features 43 scripts, a Pumpkin Night Shell design, spooky visual effects, a Halloween intro, live FPS/PING/MEM monitoring, and full favorites, pinned, recent, and search systems.  
​Features
​Auto Steal & Auto Place: Automates stealing and placing mechanics.  
​Auto Hatch & Equip Best: Automatically hatches eggs and equips your best items.  
​Auto Upgrade & Auto Rebirth: Automates your character upgrades and rebirth progressions.  
​x2 Train & Zone Selector: Multiplies your training speed and lets you switch zones effortlessly.  
​Halloween-Themed GUI: Full-screen custom UI with a spooky atmosphere, live FPS, ping, memory status, and search functionality.  
​Mobile & PC Support: Fully optimized to run smoothly across both mobile and desktop executors.  
​Unreviewed Remote Payload: Note that the remote payload has not been independently reviewed.

Auto Steal, Auto Place, Auto Hatch, Equip Best, Auto Upgrade, Auto Rebirth, x2 Train, Zone Selector, and a Halloween-themed GUI. Mobile and PC support. Remote payload has not been independently reviewed.
